input.message:
Dear Landlord,

Re: 27 Thistle Lane, Brackley Vale, ZZ3 9ZZ – bedroom radiator not heating (ref R/12)

Thank you for approving this job with Harlow Heating up to £150. We have contacted them, and unfortunately they are fully booked until 3 November. They have offered an emergency visit sooner, but at double their normal rate. They have not given us a figure for that.

As you asked us not to go outside Harlow or above £150 without checking with you first, we need your decision on one of these options:

1. Quick Fix Heating: they can attend on Monday 6 October. Their quote for inspecting the radiator and replacing the valve is £230 including parts. This is £80 above your £150 limit, and they are not Harlow.
2. Harlow Heating emergency visit: sooner, at double rate. We would get you their price before booking.
3. Wait for Harlow's normal availability from 3 November, within your £150 limit. The bedroom would stay without heating until then. The rest of the house is heating normally.

Reply APPROVE to go ahead with Quick Fix Heating at £230. Or tell us if you would prefer option 2 or 3, and we will arrange it.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team

input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting the bedroom radiator at 27 Thistle Lane, Brackley Vale (ref R/12). The landlord's usual heating engineer has no availability in the short term. We have found another engineer and are waiting for the landlord to confirm how to proceed. We will contact you as soon as we have a decision and a visit date.

In the meantime, please check that the valves at both ends of the radiator are turned fully open. If there is a thermostatic dial, please turn it to its highest setting. Please don't take anything apart.

Is anyone in the household elderly, unwell, very young or otherwise vulnerable to the cold? If so, please let us know so we can treat this as a priority.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
